patch_description: Key changes: (1) 6 diverse structured seeds (lattice, perturbed hexagon, concentric rings, vertices+edge splits, and multiple fixed-seed Dirichlet samples) replacing the 1+10 random starts, since structured starts dominate; (2) gradient-like softmin phase using a temperature-annealed soft objective with candidate batching and best-of-k acceptance, with more iterations per start; (3) hard refine restricted to the binding minimum-triangle points with annealed step and stochastic targeted kicks, plus final polishing; (4) vectorized precomputed triplet index arrays for all area evaluations to cut runtime so the larger budget fits the same time envelope. Deterministic fixed seeds throughout.
